name: Soothing Spices
summary: "Swamp Eye" Jarl loves cooking, swamp style, and needs soothing spice for a stew. Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh asks you to bring three Soothing Spices.

sections.title: Spice for the Pot
sections.body: "Swamp Eye" Jarl is fond of cooking in the swamp manner, with fried green frog legs among the dishes. A stew is planned, and for it Jarl needs soothing spice. Whoever brings it will be given a share. Jarl wants three Soothing Spices, and wonders whether you like stew.

faq.answer: "Swamp Eye" Jarl, who is found in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What does Swamp Eye Jarl intend to cook with the spices?
faq.answer: A stew. Jarl is fond of swamp cooking, fried green frog legs for one, and plans to share the stew with you.

faq.q: How many spices does Jarl need?
faq.answer: Jarl asks for three Soothing Spices.
